challenges: グェン = Nguyen vs グェン・ビェン・ボー = Guen Bien Bo (both official in jigoku_glossary.json, from akurasu/fandom): inconsistent. The glossary itself cites https://fullmetalpanic.fandom.com/wiki/Nguyen_Bien_Bo for the short form; the full name should be "Nguyen Bien Bo" (not in my brief, found while checking the cast).

アンドレイ・セルゲイヴィッチ・カリーニン "Andrei Sergeivich Kalinin" (akurasu, official): ANN English dub credits (https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=18796) and https://fullmetalpanic.fandom.com/wiki/Andrey_Kalinin write "Andrey Kalinin". Akurasu wins by precedence, so low priority; listed only for the record.
Jigoku glossary 神楽坂恵理 = Eri Kagurazaka: Tengoku CHFN uses the variant kanji 神楽坂恵里 (kept as a separate name record); the glossary key for the Tengoku spelling must be added, not a rename.
retoken: pilot 356 DSC2: $$水星$$ -> $$水星#fmp$$ (the art teacher Mizuhoshi; bare 水星 is the planet Mercury and may be reused by other groups)
uncertain: Novel-only cast (Sabina, Fowler, Casper, Kurama, Nami, Lemon, Mira Kudan, Courtney): I found no book edition spelling. Spellings come from the licensed English dub credits on ANN (Full Metal Panic! Invisible Victory) plus the franchise wiki, and they differ from the translators' romanizations (Kasper->Casper, Refnio->Rechnio). ANN lists "Sabina (Rechnio)" and "Wilhelm Casper".
ハンカ自治州: precedence gave Jigoku's shipped "Hanka Autonomous Region"; the wiki and geography use "Khanka" (Lake Khanka). Orchestrator may prefer Khanka.
サックス / エドワード・ブルーザー・サックス: nothing found online; whole spelling unverified. Gender male comes from 彼の死 in pilot 359 DSC2.
エリゴール: Eligor chosen over the wiki title Erigor by the demon-name pattern (Alastor, Belial, Behemoth, Leviathan).

西太平洋戦隊 / 地中海戦隊: Jigoku ships both "West Pacific fleet" and "Western Pacific fleet"; the wiki Mithril page says "West Pacific Fleet" and "Mediterranean Sea Fleet". Chose Western Pacific Fleet and Mediterranean Fleet.
水星 = Mizuhoshi comes from MyAnimeList (Iori Mizuhoshi, 水星庵) only; art teacher's gender not settled by any source (marked unknown).

ジョン・ジョージ・コートニー gender male is weak evidence (English voice actor). Ono D, Oonuki, Akagi etc.: Oonuki (357) and Akagi (358) gender comes from the Jigoku English pronouns (the Japanese has none) plus series knowledge; medium confidence.
Nami (342): the game DSC2 says she is shot dead by Kurama; the fandom wiki trivia says she survives in Z3.2. The profile follows the game text.
Pilot 334 Kalinin: the game entry calls him ミスタ・Ｋ（カリウム） = "Mr. K (Potassium)"; ANN dub credits list "Mister Natrium/Gold/Copper" for other executives, consistent.

Short katakana forms ミラ, ナミ, レモン, サックス, クラマ collide with common words but a scan of the other name_research briefs found no shared Japanese key; only 水星 needed a token. 赤城 (FMP) and 赤木 (Dai-Guard) are different keys with the same English "Akagi".
Shared spellings checked against other briefs: none of my names appear in the other groups' lists except ナミ/ナミダ (different) and 赤城/赤木 (different kanji).
